_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0/72 windows breaking ±2 points, extreme positioning metrics (long_short 99, CVD 96, reserves 97) have no release valve — the coil holds until a catalyst breaks it, and the analyst's higher trust weight (7.67 vs 6.00) tips the forward lean toward Disbelief rather than Hope.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst calls Disbelief (downward), narrative implies Hope (upward); I side with the analyst per trust weights and the statistical coil evidence.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding drops below 0.003% with fear_greed staying below 35 and VIX spiking above 18
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks $65K with volume and funding rises above 0.01%
